topic: Hardening code against vulnerabilities: untrusted input handling, authentication, data storage, external integrations, session management, dependency vulnerability triage, supply-chain risk, GDPR/CCPA privacy compliance

subtopics.scope: Threat model first: map trust boundaries (including locally-sourced values and LLM output), name assets, run STRIDE per boundary, write abuse cases next to use cases; OWASP A04 Insecure Design.
seed_queries: STRIDE threat modeling trust boundaries application security
OWASP A04 Insecure Design threat modeling abuse cases

subtopics.scope: The skill's three-tier boundary system: Always Do (no exceptions), Ask First (human approval), Never Do; internal-record from the source doc.
OWASP Top 10 prevention patterns: injection, broken authentication, XSS, broken access control, security misconfiguration, sensitive data exposure, with concrete code patterns.
seed_queries: OWASP Top 10 prevention SQL injection XSS broken access control patterns
security headers CSP helmet express CORS configuration best practices

subtopics.scope: Server-side request forgery: allowlisted scheme and host, resolving all DNS records and rejecting private/reserved ranges, redirect handling, and the DNS-rebinding TOCTOU gap.
seed_queries: SSRF prevention allowlist DNS rebinding TOCTOU webhook URL validation
OWASP server side request forgery prevention cheat sheet

subtopics.scope: Schema validation at system boundaries (zod pattern), file upload safety: type and size limits, magic bytes over extension trust.
seed_queries: zod schema validation API boundary input validation best practices
file upload security magic bytes MIME validation best practices

subtopics.scope: Destructive operations on derived paths: allowlisted root after symlink resolution, minimum depth below root, ownership evidence read before the operation, TOCTOU and check/use races.
seed_queries: path traversal symlink race TOCTOU destructive file operations mitigation
CWE-22 path traversal allowlist root defense symlink following

subtopics.scope: Triage of dependency audit findings by severity and reachability, plus supply-chain hygiene: lockfile, npm ci, dependency review, typosquats, postinstall scripts, signature verification, no forced audit fixes.
seed_queries: npm audit triage reachability vulnerability severity decision tree
npm supply chain security lockfile npm ci typosquat postinstall provenance signatures

subtopics.scope: Operational controls: rate limiting with shared stores behind multiple instances and on serverless, plus secrets management: env file discipline, pre-commit checks, rotation after exposure.
seed_queries: express-rate-limit shared store redis serverless distributed rate limiting
secrets management environment variables leaked credential rotation git history

subtopics.scope: Data privacy and compliance: classification (non-personal, PII, sensitive), minimization, retention with working deletion paths, data-subject rights (GDPR/CCPA), consent and third-party sharing, localization of defaults.
seed_queries: GDPR CCPA data minimization retention deletion engineering implementation
data subject rights export delete backups search indexes analytics GDPR

subtopics.scope: Securing AI/LLM features per OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: output as untrusted input, prompt injection, secrets in prompts, excessive agency, unbounded consumption, vector and embedding weaknesses.
seed_queries: OWASP Top 10 LLM applications 2025 prompt injection output handling
LLM agent excessive agency RAG vector store poisoning security
